set.body:
Scope: mvpa-spatial reusable region/searchlight/scatter APIs; mvpa4s locus/image and optional neuroim4s integration.

Deliverable: Move reusable region/searchlight measurements over provider domains and image values; keep neuroimaging refinements in an optional adapter. Surface and atlas adapters follow in U6; functional threshold policy stays in ScalaFIM.

Acceptance:
- Generic locus/image adapters use provider APIs directly; core/predictive have no image or neuroim4s dependency.
- Volume measurements preserve ordering, masking, wrong-domain rejection and scatter behavior on JVM/JS.
- No duplicate domain/image wrapper, searchlight model or spatial kernel is introduced.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U4: Extract optional locus and image measurement adapters
